models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Authenticated user accounts for the Todo list application.

Stores core user identity and authentication credentials for individuals who register and use the system. Each user account provides complete data isolation, ensuring users can only access their own todo items and personal information.

Users authenticate using email and password, with passwords stored as cryptographically secure hashes using bcrypt. The email address serves as the unique identifier for login and account recovery purposes.

User accounts support the complete lifecycle from registration through active use to optional deletion with 30-day soft delete recovery period. The system maintains creation and modification timestamps for audit purposes.

All user data is completely isolated - no user can access another user's information or todo items under any circumstances. This table forms the foundation of the application's security model through proper authentication and authorization enforcement.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User email address for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all users and serves as the login identifier. Validated for proper email format and used for account recovery.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Cryptographically hashed password using bcrypt with cost factor of at least 12. Never stored in plain text. Used for authentication verification during login.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: User's display name for personalization. Optional field that can be provided during registration or updated later. Used in welcome messages and user interface personalization.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created during registration. Immutable after creation and used for account age tracking and audit purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last modification to user profile information. Updated whenever email, password, or name is changed. Used for tracking account activity.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating when user requested account deletion. Null for active accounts. When set, account enters 30-day recovery period before permanent deletion. Used to support account recovery and data retention policies.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
User authentication session tracking for JWT token management.

Records active user sessions for authenticated access to the Todo list application. Each session represents a login instance from a specific device or browser, tracking connection context and session lifecycle.

Sessions are created upon successful user login and store connection metadata including IP address, connection URL, and referrer information for security auditing. The session tracks when it was created and when it expires to enforce authentication timeout policies.

Supports multiple concurrent sessions per user, allowing login from different devices simultaneously. Sessions can be individually revoked through logout functionality or bulk revoked when user changes password or requests "logout from all devices".

Used for audit tracing of user actions and maintaining secure authentication state through JWT refresh token management. Session expiration follows configured timeout policies (7 days standard, 30 days with "Remember Me").

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who owns this session. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the user connected and created this session. Used for security monitoring and detecting suspicious login patterns from unusual locations.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was initiated. Captures the full URL of the login request for audit and debugging purposes.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL indicating where the user came from before logging in. Used for tracking user acquisition sources and navigation patterns.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created during user login. Marks the beginning of the authenticated session period.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires or was explicitly terminated. Null for active sessions. Set upon logout, password change, or automatic expiration after timeout period.

models.name: todo_list_password_reset_tokens
models.description:
Password reset tokens for secure account recovery.

Stores temporary, time-limited tokens sent via email when users request password resets. Each token is cryptographically secure, single-use, and expires after 1 hour to maintain security.

Tokens are created when users initiate password reset through the "Forgot Password" flow. The system generates a unique token, stores it with the user's email, and sends a reset link containing the token. When users click the reset link, the system validates the token hasn't expired or been used, then allows password update.

After successful password reset or token expiration, tokens are permanently deleted from the system. This table supports the self-service password recovery mechanism while maintaining strict security controls.

Multiple tokens can exist for the same user if they request password reset multiple times before using a token, though only unexpired tokens are valid for password reset operations.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who requested the password reset. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Cryptographically secure random token sent in password reset email. Must be unique across all active tokens to prevent collisions. Used to verify password reset requests.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address where the password reset link was sent. Stored for validation to ensure the token is used with the correct email, providing additional security layer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was generated. Used to calculate token expiration (tokens expire 1 hour after creation).

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token becomes invalid. Set to 1 hour after creation. System rejects password reset attempts using expired tokens.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was successfully used to reset password. Null for unused tokens. Once set, the token cannot be reused, enforcing single-use security requirement.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
Todo items representing user tasks and action items.

Stores individual todo entries created by authenticated users to track tasks, goals, and action items. Each todo belongs to exactly one user and maintains complete data isolation between users.

Todos support rich metadata including titles, descriptions, due dates, priority levels, and completion status. The status field tracks workflow progression between pending and completed states, allowing users to mark tasks as done while preserving the todo for historical reference.

The priority field enforces strict validation at the database level to ensure only valid priority values (low, medium, high) are stored, preventing data integrity issues from any data entry method including direct database access, migrations, or third-party integrations.

Soft deletion is implemented through the deleted_at timestamp, providing a 30-day recovery period before permanent deletion. Deleted todos remain in the database but are filtered from normal queries, allowing users to restore accidentally deleted items.

Categories provide optional organization capabilities, allowing users to group related todos without requiring categorization for basic functionality.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user who created this todo item. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_category_id
foreignFields.description: Optional category for organizing related todos. {@link todo_list_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Brief description of the task to be completed. Required field serving as the primary identifier users see for each todo item. Maximum length 200 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed notes or additional context about the todo item. Optional field supporting longer explanations, instructions, or related information. Maximum length 2000 characters.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional deadline or target completion date for this todo item. Users can set due dates to track time-sensitive tasks and receive reminders. Supports past dates for tracking overdue items.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Priority level indicating task urgency or importance. Database-enforced enum with valid values: low, medium, high. Defaults to medium if not specified. Helps users identify which tasks require immediate attention. CHECK constraint ensures data integrity at database level.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current completion status of the todo item. Database-enforced enum with valid values: pending (incomplete), completed (finished). Defaults to pending for new todos. Status can transition freely between pending and completed as users toggle completion state. CHECK constraint ensures data integrity at database level.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo item was originally created. Automatically set by the system upon creation and never modified. Used for displaying creation dates and sorting todos chronologically.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this todo item was last modified. Automatically updated whenever any field changes including status toggles, title edits, or metadata updates. Tracks most recent activity on the todo.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp indicating when the user deleted this todo. Null for active todos. When set, the todo is hidden from normal views but retained for 30 days to support recovery. After 30 days, todos are permanently deleted.

models.name: todo_list_categories
models.description:
Categories for organizing and grouping related todo items.

Provides optional organizational structure allowing users to group related todos into named categories such as Work, Personal, Shopping, or Health. Each category belongs to a specific user and maintains data isolation.

Categories are entirely optional - users can manage todos without categorization. When used, categories help users filter and organize large todo lists by applying category-based views.

The system supports user-specific categories, meaning each user maintains their own category list independent of other users. Category names are validated for uniqueness per user to prevent confusion.

Future enhancements may include category sharing, hierarchical categories, or default system categories, which this normalized structure supports without schema modifications.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner user who created this category. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category name for organizing todos. Required field representing the user-visible category label such as Work, Personal, Shopping, or Health. Maximum length 50 characters. Must be unique per user.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was originally created. Automatically set by the system upon creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was last modified. Automatically updated whenever the category name or other properties change.
